glosses: A mark on any scale of measurement; a unit of measurement.

glosses: A bird seen (or heard) by a birdwatcher, for the first time that day, year, trip, etc., and thus added to a list of observed birds.

examples.text: There are few birders who have not had stringy ticks on their lists at some stage.
